rules.population: Every source record in the frozen, validated full catalog.
rules.near_ceiling: Highest archived value per source record; declared percent, higher is better, all numeric values in [0,100], highest >=95. Preserve every tied observation and its instrument, protocol, model and citation. Not a repeated-run or saturation claim. Unknown scales and scores remain in the census.
rules.mentions: Distinct model-report documents and named organizations per source record. Table includes every record mentioned by at least six organizations. Report registry scope only; not field-wide adoption or unique test versions.
rules.gaps: At least 180 days between the latest publication date of a document supplying an archived score and the latest publication date of a mentioning report, within the same source record. Not evaluation dates or stagnation.
rules.metric: Exact model-reports record key joins the frozen score archive only to annotate metric names; no records, scores, or scales are added by this join.
